'''Gwe-Ro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]]. In the [[Spirit World]] at the [[Shrine of Healing]] he asked potential [[Voss Mystics]] questions as part of their trials and judged their responses.<ref name="The Trials" />
